cohort: The study included 170 pregnant women admitted with 3rd trimester stillbirths, of all parity, and more than 28 weeks of pregnancy with a Bishop's score of <=6, excluding those already in labor, with intrapartum stillbirths, or multiple gestation.
finding: Early induction of 3rd trimester stillbirths is an acceptable option, achieving vaginal delivery in 94.8% of cases, with 93% delivering within 24 hours, and was associated with less morbidity.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was achieved in 161 (94.8%) cases, while 9 (5.2%) cases required cesarean delivery.
